card.title: Debts on the Scoreboard
card.instruction: Treat past wins and losses as debts. Let each new result change who owes the next favor, risk, or concession.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You beat me at darts yesterday, so you owe me lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. But you've just beaten me today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then lunch cancels out. I owe you dessert for winning by more.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Make it takeaway. I have to collect Mum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll collect her. A three-dart finish ought to cover a parent, not just a pudding.
